newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX expects boost from international links - TV.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX expects boost from international links - TV.

text.p: The Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) is poised to become the Asia-Pacific centre for futures trading, state television quoted SIMEX chairman Victor Liew as saying in SIMEX's annual report on Thursday.
International links with other exchanges were a key element in that outlook.

Liew said the exchange's development would be greatly helped by mutual offset links established last year with the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) for Eurodollar and Euroyen futures contracts, state TV reported.
It said linking the Euroyen with the CME has led to 25 percent growth in SIMEX Euroyen volumes over 1996 to a record 8.2 million contracts.
With the success of those ties, SIMEX said in the annual report it made the ideal partner for Western exchanges seeking a strategic link in Asia, state television reported.
